advisories.summary: Integer Overflow in Shape Inference Data Propagation (MathOpTwoIntegers + Concat)
advisories.reason: Bundled ONNX 1.22.0 is <1.23.0; ORT graph inference calls ONNX schema inference and data propagation. Upstream demonstrates incorrect dimensions, not memory corruption.
advisories.binary_evidence: llvm-nm confirms MathOpTwoIntegers(string const&, int, int) in the selected macOS archive; ORT graph.cc executes schema inference and data propagation. Upstream fix changes arithmetic to checked 64-bit.

osv.limitation: No commit matches is not a security clearance; package/language-specific upstream advisories independently found affected ONNX 1.22.0.

directml.distribution: Not bundled in DAW ZIP; executable imports system DirectML.dll DMLCreateDevice1. NuGet runtime has Microsoft proprietary redistribution terms; source/import headers have MIT terms.

apple_compiler_runtime.licenses: Apple installed LLVM acknowledgment (NCSA) plus upstream current Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and legacy MIT/NCSA notices retained conservatively; no claim that Apple vendor source exactly matches an upstream tag.

inspected_packages.execution: Static inspection only; foreign-platform executables were not run.

limitations: System DLLs/frameworks/shared libraries are supplied and updated by the destination OS; their versions are not vendored or pinned by Cargo.
No fresh clean-machine Windows/Linux launch, runtime inference or ARM package execution; arm64 native archives were checksum/static inspected.
Artifact supplier does not ship a per-archive signed SBOM; source-derived closure is pinned to embedded ORT commit and corroborated by members, not a reproducible-build attestation.

advisory_sources.nvd_disposition: No DirectML or ONNX Runtime keyword records returned; compiler-rt keyword match CVE-2023-53182 concerns Linux ACPICA, not the linked Apple availability builtin. Keyword absence is not a security clearance.

package_imports.macos: Only Apple system dylibs/frameworks; includes CoreML, Foundation, Accelerate and libc++. No @rpath ONNX library.
